title: Swarmhold deployment diagram
description: How Swarmhold runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and no storage. The browser runs the Godot WebAssembly export (WebGL 2). The engine's .wasm is larger than Cloudflare's 25 MiB limit for a static file, so build.mjs splits it into index.wasm.0, .1 and the Worker streams the parts back as one index.wasm.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the Godot WebAssembly export (WebGL 2) and boot.js.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on the route icelander.net/games/retro/swarmhold* and serves static assets from ./dist.

nodes.name: swarmhold Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts. Runs first for the page (sign-in) and /games/retro/swarmhold/index.wasm; every other path is a static asset.

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository (accounts/): who holds the host's site_session cookie and their games: roles. The Worker reaches it only through a service binding.

artifacts.name: index.html, index.js, index.pck
artifacts.description: Godot's Web export (preset Web, release, single-threaded), with web_shell/shell.html as the page.

artifacts.name: index.wasm.0, index.wasm.1
artifacts.description: The Godot engine's WebAssembly, cut into 20 MiB parts; the Worker joins them for /games/retro/swarmhold/index.wasm.

artifacts.name: _headers, boot.js, shell.css, favicon.svg
artifacts.description: The Content-Security-Policy and other headers, the script that starts the engine, the loading screen's styles and the icon.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler with the sign-in check, bundled by wrangler.
